propositions: The tests overlay (criteria_routing.json, tests rule at 0.54 confidence) is selected only by glob match on changed files (**/test_*.py, **/*_test.py, **/tests/**), missing coverage gaps when source adds declarations but no test file changes.

Four real commits (388/d9e0f0e733, 1920/721cb7d6ac, 1737/1c2bf6e57b, 1703/83d91d488c) added 8-22 declarations with zero test files, and later code motion and three bugs resulted; the glob rule did not fire on any of them.

The overlay must fire on content: an added line matching the polyglot _REMOVED_DECL_RE (def/class/func/fn/function) whose declared name is not also removed in the same file, provided no changed file matches the tests globs.

Guard (vii) must narrow from all coverage gaps to only those introducing new behaviour (ADDED lines in the diff) with a named violating input (concrete value or call sequence in the finding), so pre-existing code paths stay advisory.

content_triggered_overlays requires a new keyword-only changed_files parameter and per-file provenance (_DECL_NAME_RE) to suppress annotation-only rewrites and distinguish moves (delete+add in different files) from inline replacements.
